title: majana paniculata
intro: Majana paniculata, commonly known as "Wild Jasmine" or "Poisonous Jasmine", is a flowering plant native to tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Majana paniculata include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. However, it is essential to note that Majana paniculata is also toxic and should be handled with caution, as excessive consumption can lead to adverse effects.
